description: The illegal immigration problem in America is not about crime or racism, it is a breach of fairness, like slavery that is not indefinitely sustainable. By not addressing undocumented immigration the two major parties have conspired, either by choice or voluntary negligence, to endanger our national security and to create a two-tiered economic American Apartheid, where an underclass is exploited for the benefit of others, who are usually special interests taking most of those benefits. A coherent immigration policy with effective management and operational control can benefit our economy and society.
